summary: Tested the user-blocking feature on the backend and frontend at 375x667. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (create, validation 422/400/404/409/401, status in both directions, admin list, hiding and enforcement on tutors, map, tutor by id, tutor by user, parent public profile, threads, thread, messages, invitations, invitation accept and bookings, cascade on account delete). Frontend: the chat, tutor-profile, parent-profile and admin-panel flows all work. Cancel and X both work. Submit stays disabled until a reason is picked and the box is ticked, and 'other' needs 10 or more characters of details. One functional bug: right after blocking from the tutor profile, Done goes back to an Explore list that is out of date and still shows the blocked tutor until the screen reloads. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files reviewed.

minor.issue: Neither endpoint checks blocks. A blocked parent can still post a review on the tutor, and the blocker still sees the blocked person's reviews.
Still returns IDs of blocked tutors. The client then gets 404 when it fetches them.
Deleting an account also deletes its blocks. A blocked user can delete their account and sign up again with the same email to get around the permanent block. The blocks were not tied to email.
Capped at 500 rows with no pagination.

ui_bugs.issue: After blocking from the tutor profile, Done calls router.dismissTo('/(tabs)') and goes back to the Explore screen that is already mounted. Its tutor list and map pins are loaded only by useEffect (no focus refetch), so the blocked tutor's card stays visible until the page reloads or a filter changes. Confirmed: card count was 1 right after Done and 0 after a fresh load.
Shows only plain text 'Tutor not found' with no back button or header. On web or a deep link the user is stuck. Blocked users now land here.

issues: The empty state 'Say hi 👋' shows next to the 'You can no longer message each other.' banner, which contradicts it. Hide the empty state or change its text when blocked.
Cancel calls router.back() with no canGoBack fallback (X has one), so Cancel does nothing on a deep link.
If blocker or blocked is null, the role renders as '()' after 'Deleted user'. The blocker's email is not shown, only the blocked person's.

action_items: Explore (app/(tabs)/index.tsx): refetch /tutors and /tutors/map on focus (useFocusEffect), or pass a refresh signal after blocking, so a blocked tutor disappears right away after Done.
Add a back/header button to the tutor 'not found' state (app/tutor/[id].tsx:48).
Block screen Cancel: use the same canGoBack() fallback as the X button.
Chat: hide the 'Say hi 👋' empty state when blocked.

Hide the block buttons (chat-block-btn, tutor-block-btn, parent-block-btn) when the other user is an admin, or when the viewer is an admin. The backend refuses to block admins, so the user only sees an error toast.
Optional: apply blocked_between to POST /reviews and filter blocked tutors out of /favorites.
Optional: decide whether deleting an account should keep a block record (for example keyed by email hash) so a blocked user can't sign up again to get around a permanent block.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: blocked_between and blocked_user_ids are applied consistently. Admins bypass the block on /parents/{id}/public as intended. A unique index on (blocker_id, blocked_id) prevents duplicates.
Chat, tutor and parent block buttons appear for any logged-in user who is not the owner, including chats with admins. Admin targets return 400, so the user just gets a 'Couldn't block' toast.
server.py is 1861 lines (more than 700). Splitting it into routes/ modules should continue.
On the tutor profile, the reviews request runs in Promise.all with /tutors/{id}. Either one failing leaves the tutor as null, which is fine here, but the error is swallowed silently.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 6 requested flows pass; one stale-list bug on Explore after Done)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ parent and tutor accounts through signup for pytest and for the UI tests (seed_session11_blocks_ui.py). All were deleted with DELETE /api/auth/me. GET /api/admin/blocks returned 0 rows after cleanup. Seeded accounts (sofia, parent@test.dev) were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blocks are permanent, so never block between seeded accounts. Use seed_session11_blocks_ui.py seed/cleanup (it writes tokens to /tmp/blocks_ui_accounts.json). A fresh parent needs PATCH /parents/me/profile before /parents/{id}/public returns 200. pytest.ini uses xdist (-n), so don't pass -p no:xdist.
rca_of_issue: Stale Explore after a block: block/[userId].tsx exit() calls router.dismissTo('/(tabs)'), which shows the Explore tab that is already mounted. Explore loads tutors through useEffect([load]) and map pins through useEffect([]), and neither runs again on focus. The backend already hides the tutor correctly (a fresh load shows 0 cards). Fix: use useFocusEffect in Explore. Messages already does this, which is why the chat flow updates correctly.
